description.short: Configure, price and quote products in Elfsquad CPQ from Microsoft 365 Copilot.
description.full:
Elfsquad is a configure-price-quote (CPQ) platform for manufacturers of configurable products. This agent connects Microsoft 365 Copilot to Elfsquad through the Elfsquad MCP server. You sign in with your Elfsquad account and choose one environment; the agent then works in that environment with your own roles and permissions.

With it you can build and review feature models (features, structure, rules and expressions), configure a product and read its price, options and conflicts, turn configurations into quotations, look up and update quotations and CRM accounts, query your Elfsquad data, and search the Elfsquad documentation.

Each user has Read or Write access for the connector per environment. Read is the default; changes to data need Write access, which an administrator of the environment grants. The agent asks before anything that deletes.

Requires an Elfsquad account. New to Elfsquad? [Request a demo](https://www.elfsquad.io/demo) to get started.

Help and support: [Contact Elfsquad](https://www.elfsquad.io/contact-us)
